recognize_zh: 視野內幾乎全為脂肪細胞，殘存造血細胞只沿脂肪間隙呈細條分布，看不到巨核細胞聚集或異常細胞浸潤；這是明顯低細胞性骨髓，符合 GATA2 缺乏症（Emberger syndrome）常見的低細胞骨髓表現。（此圖與 60089 為同一視野，僅色調不同。）
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow with near-total replacement by adipocytes
Residual hematopoiesis limited to narrow interstitial strands between fat cells
Residual cells mostly small round mononuclear cells with interstitial red cells
No megakaryocytes or dysplastic megakaryocyte clusters visible at this power
No fibrosis, blast aggregates, or granulomas
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypocellular marrow in which the marrow space is almost entirely occupied by adipose tissue. Residual hematopoietic elements form thin interstitial strands composed predominantly of small mononuclear cells with interstitial hemorrhage; megakaryocytes are not identified in this field. There is no fibrosis or aggregate of blasts at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular marrow; in GATA2 deficiency (Emberger syndrome), assessment for hypocellular MDS requires evaluation of megakaryocyte dysplasia, CD34 immunostaining, and cytogenetics, and the typical monocytopenia and B/NK lymphopenia should be confirmed by flow cytometry. Note: this image appears to be the same microscopic field as record 60089 with different white balance.

ddx.vs: Histologically similar fatty marrow; GATA2 deficiency is suggested by profound monocytopenia, B- and NK-cell lymphopenia, atypical infections, lymphedema, and germline GATA2 mutation.
Requires dysplastic (often small, hypolobated) megakaryocytes, increased CD34+ cells, or clonal karyotype such as monosomy 7, which cannot be demonstrated in this fatty field.

ddx.dx: Dyskeratosis congenita / other telomere biology disorders
ddx.vs: Similar aplastic histology; separated by telomere length testing and germline sequencing rather than morphology.
HCL shows interstitial fried-egg lymphoid cells with reticulin fibrosis and CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positivity, not seen in this bland fatty marrow.
